title: Shiv Sena members tear pages of Sonia Gandhi’s book over Savarkar references, seek ban in Maharashtra

ai.summary: Shiv Sena members tore pages from Sonia Gandhi's memoir Belonging, demanding the publisher remove two pages with alleged Savarkar references and a Maharashtra government ban on the book's sale in the state.

facts.claim: Shiv Sena members tore pages from Sonia Gandhi's memoir Belonging
facts.quote: Members of Shiv Sena on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) tore pages from Sonia Gandhi's memoir Belonging: A Journey of Love, demanding that the publisher withdraw two pages that the party claimed contained objectionable references to Vinayak Damodar Savarkar.

facts.claim: Shiv Sena demanded the publisher withdraw two pages with alleged Savarkar references
facts.quote: We have torn the pages of the book as a mark of protest against the statements on Savarkar ji. We have sought that Harper Collins, the publisher, should scrap these two pages.

facts.claim: Shiv Sena sought a Maharashtra government ban on the book's sale in the state
facts.quote: Till they do that, we have sought that the Maharashtra government ban the sale of the book in the State.

ai.background_note: Shiv Sena members tore pages from Sonia Gandhi's memoir Belonging, demanding the publisher withdraw two pages with alleged Savarkar references and a Maharashtra government ban on the book's sale in the state.
